stem.text: An aeroplane can fly at a velocity $X$ when moving through still air. When flying in wind the aeroplane's velocity relative to the ground is $Y$.
Which vector diagram shows the magnitude and direction of the wind velocity $W$?

A.alt: Vector diagram with arrows labelled X, Y and W.

B.alt: Vector diagram with arrows labelled X, Y and W.

C.alt: Vector diagram with arrows labelled X, Y and W.

D.alt: Vector diagram with arrows labelled X, Y and W.
